title: Principal Creative Director, AI Video
description: Who We Are Is What We Do. Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers. Why should you be part of our success story? As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are. Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google. Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work. About The Studio Deel is one of the fastest-growing companies in the world, and we're building the brand and creative studio to match. We make global campaigns, partnerships, film, design, and social at real scale, for businesses and for workers in almost every country there is. We're looking for someone exceptional to raise the bar on what we make. This is a hands-on role. You'd set the standard by making the work. The role Deel is a truly global, people-first brand, and it's taking off. We're looking for a creative director who works at the front edge of AI-native production across video and design. Most AI creative work is technically impressive and creatively empty. Some of it is good work that used AI somewhere in the pipeline. We think there's a real discipline in between, and we want you to build it here. You'd define how we make this work, and you'd prove it by making it. This is a hands-on role. What You'll Make AI-native creative. Work where generative tools are central to how it's made, at a standard the category hasn't reached. The stack. Our AI creative tooling and the workflows around it, including the principles for where we don't use it. Video and motion. Brand films, campaign work, and product storytelling that blend traditional and AI-led production. A repeatable method. Something the rest of the team can use, so the capability outlives any one project. What You Bring At least ten years across video, motion, or design, with direction as well as production. Recent work made or directed with generative AI that stands up as creative work first. Deep knowledge of the current tooling, and clear judgment about where it breaks. Proven ability to build a workflow other people can actually use. A point of view on likeness, disclosure, and provenance. We take these seriously. What Would Set You Apart A reel with range across live-action, motion, and generative work. Experience establishing an AI practice inside a creative team. A public point of view on AI in creative work. Who You'll Work With You'll sit inside the creative studio and work alongside our Creative Director, the video and motion teams, and the brand designers who'll build on what you establish. How We Work We're a studio, not a request queue. People here make things rather than manage from a distance. We use AI seriously, and we're deliberate about where we don't. Total Rewards Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all. Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission. Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion. Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location. We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it. Some things you'll enjoy Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Unless otherwise agreed, we will communicate with job applicants using Deel-specific emails, which include @ deel.com and other acquired company emails like @ payspace.com and @ paygroup.com . You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting our careers page . Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation. As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. title: Creative Director
description:
WHO WE ARE

Come join the company reinventing data security, empowering businesses to realize the full potential of their data. As the leading data security platform purpose-built for the cloud era, Cyera’s mission is to reinvent how businesses secure data, enable agile collaboration, and boldly pursue new business opportunities. Trusted by security teams at leading global businesses, our team is proving that data security is the next big thing in cyber. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data security.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re hiring a Creative Director to bring Cyera’s brand to life across every campaign and every touchpoint where a customer, prospect, or employee meets us. Reporting to the Head of Corporate Marketing, you will be a key strategic leader of Cyera’s brand and a core creative voice on the marketing leadership team.
This is not an execution-only role. We’re looking for a creative leader who pairs strong visual instincts with strong writing, and who treats every campaign as a chance to tell a story people remember. You’ll partner closely with Design Studio, Integrated Marketing, and other functions across marketing to make sure Cyera’s brand shows up with the same craft and clarity everywhere it appears, and you’ll lead a small creative team that you’ll be expected to grow, in capability and in ambition.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Brand storytelling across campaigns. Turn Cyera’s positioning and messaging into campaigns that fuse strong visuals with strong copy. Define and build briefs that serve as a guide to make every campaign feel like one idea, carried consistently across every channel and format.
Creative direction for key touchpoints. Set the creative bar for the moments that matter most: launches, events, the website, sales collateral, social, and executive communications. Make sure the brand feels like one brand, wherever someone meets it.
Partnership with Design Studio. Work hand in hand with Design Studio to turn creative concepts into finished work. Bring clear direction, sharp feedback, and a point of view that raises the level of what gets made.
Partnership with Integrated Marketing. Sit alongside Integrated Marketing from the start of campaign planning, so creative is built into strategy rather than added at the end. Help turn campaign briefs into ideas that earn attention.
Creative team leadership. Lead, coach, and grow a small creative team across Copy and Video. Model the craft, help your team members develop into stronger creative thinkers, and build the bench for Cyera’s next stage of growth.
Brand stewardship. Act as a guardian of Cyera’s voice and identity across the company. Give partners across marketing, sales, and product the creative guardrails they need to move fast without losing consistency.

QUALIFICATIONS

10-12 years of creative experience, including time as an art director, creative director, or similar role, ideally at a B2B technology company or a category-defining brand.
A portfolio that proves the partnership between visual and copy. You can point to campaigns where the idea, the design, and the words worked as one.
Enterprise brand experience. You know how to make a serious, technical brand feel human and memorable without losing credibility.
Hands-on craft. You can sketch a concept, sharpen a headline, or direct a shoot yourself, not just brief someone else to do it.
AI fluency. You know how to define where and how AI tools fit into the creative process, using them to raise quality and velocity together rather than trading one for the other.
Strong stakeholder management. You build trust with partners across marketing, sales, and product, and you know how to hold a creative point of view while navigating competing priorities.
People leadership. You’ve hired, coached, and grown creative talent, and people want to do their best work for you.
Collaborative range. You work well with design, marketing, and brand strategy partners, and you know how to hold a creative point of view without slowing a team down.
Operating principles that match ours, push boundaries, own and act, elevate together, and a leadership style that matches ours, model, coach, care.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION:

Compensation Range: $190,000-$230,000.

This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations.
Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements.
This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors.

BENEFITS - Why Cyera? 

Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement
Competitive salary
Unlimited PTO
Paid holidays and sick time
Health, vision, and dental insurance
Life, short and long-term disability insurance
score_reason: Strong CD role with real creative scope, AI fluency expected, and solid pay, but US-only remote may limit hiring him as his location.

title: Group Creative Director
description: Who we are: MasterClass is the streaming platform where the world's best come together so anyone, anywhere, can access and be inspired by their knowledge and stories. We put you in the room with the creators, thinkers, makers, and leaders who have changed the world so you can change yours. Members get unprecedented access to 200+ instructors and classes across various fields, including Arts & Entertainment, Business, Design & Style, Leadership, Writing, and more. Step into Issa Rae’s writing session and Gordon Ramsay's kitchen. Go behind the big screen with James Cameron. Start your career with Martha Stewart. About the Role: As our Group Creative Director, you'll report to our Executive Creative Director and help lead creative direction across Class Launches, campaigns, and product launches. You'll be hands-on, producing and elevating work across copy, design, and art direction, not just directing others' execution. Your conceptual vision and creative judgment will shape how we communicate with our global audience, and as our team structure evolves, you'll grow into a formal leadership role guiding a team of copywriters, designers, animators, editors, photographers, and art directors. What You'll Do: Lead and Inspire: Guide the creative vision and strategy for creative campaigns, products, and marketing communications. Inspire your team to push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Shape Our Voice: Write, define, and champion the tone and voice of marketing copy across various channels, ensuring consistency and authenticity. Delivering on-strategy, on-target, and on-brand messages and ensuring other writers are doing the same Stay Hands-On: Personally produce and shape copy, design, and creative work, not just direct it, across Class Launches, campaigns, and product marketing. Collaborate and Innovate: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including brand, performance marketing, enterprise, and product, to develop forward-thinking ideas and strategies. Mentor and Grow: Develop and mentor a team of copywriters, designers, and art directors, fostering a culture of creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Direct and Oversee: Provide creative direction and oversight across copy, art direction, design, video, animation, and other creative disciplines. Execute with Excellence : Deliver compelling, on-brand messages across all touchpoints, maintaining the highest quality standards and attention to detail. Adapt and Evolve: Stay ahead of industry trends and continuously seek new ways to tell our story in a rapidly changing landscape. What We're Looking For: Conceptual Visionary: Proven ability to develop original creative concepts that deliver real business impact. Sharp Creative Judgment: A track record of recognizing the strongest idea in the room and knowing how to push work further. Hands-On Maker: Comfortable personally producing copy and design work, not solely directing others, versatile across disciplines. Strategic Thinker: Able to translate strategic objectives into creative concepts that resonate, with an understanding of how creative connects to performance and conversion. Collaborative Partner: Experience working closely with cross-functional teams, including Performance Marketing, to drive integrated efforts. Visionary Leader: Proven experience leading creative teams across advertising, product, content, and creative strategy workstreams. Dynamite Storyteller: Exceptional writing skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives across various forms and mediums. Innovative Creator: A portfolio showcasing award-winning work and a knack for pushing creative boundaries. Qualifications: 10+ years of experience in creative roles, with a focus on producing standout work for global brands. Experience directing copy, art direction, design, video, animation, and other creative disciplines. Demonstrated expertise in conceptual and strategically-led campaign development. Experience in both agency and in-house environments. Ability to prioritize and work well under pressure while maintaining speed and high attention to detail given shifting timelines, updates, and last-minute changes. Should have a strong operational mindset and vision for the team. Ability to provide and receive constructive feedback across creative disciplines. Strong presentation skills and attention to detail; presenting work on behalf of the team, explaining the creative vision, strategy and approach. Experience developing and maintaining brand voice and tone guidelines. Experience and understanding of performance marketing and its integration with creative strategy. Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Versatility in writing styles and tones, from short-form brand advertising & performance copy to longer-form editorial content. At MasterClass, we believe we put our best work forward when our employees bring together ideas that are diverse in thought. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. In addition, MasterClass will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.  If you have a disability or special need, we would like to know how we can better accommodate you. The salary range listed is for NYC/CA/WA. As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled.MasterClass’s salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry. In addition to salary, we also offer equity and comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, flexible PTO, and more). The range listed is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate. Salary Range: $242,000 USD - $280,000 USD
score_reason: A true Group Creative Director role with strong pay and hands-on creative scope that matches Travis's agency pedigree almost perfectly.

title: Creative Director - Brand Narrative
description: In 1977, Charles and Ray Eames began a film with a picnic beside Chicago’s lakefront. Over the next nine minutes, Powers of Ten traveled out toward distant galaxies and back into the microscopic world inside a human hand. An enormous subject became a journey you could follow, built around a simple change in perspective. Images, language, movement, and sound brought the idea to life together. title: Creative Director
description:
Who We Are
Said Differently is an untraditional agency bringing together strategy, creativity, design and technology to build brands, campaigns, products and platforms. We create bespoke teams around each client’s needs, combining a core team with specialists across our global network. Our mission is to build the marketing agency of the future, creating exceptional work through a more flexible, collaborative way of working.

We are looking for TWO hands-on Creative Directors: one with a deep copywriting background and another who moves comfortably between art and copy. Both will develop brand platforms and integrated campaigns, lead client assignments, and collaborate with freelance specialists across our network while continuing to make work themselves.

For the copy-focused role, you can build a brand platform, develop a campaign and write the headline everyone wishes they’d written. You have exceptional writing and editing skills, strong visual judgment, and understand how words and images work together.

For the art-and-copy role, you can write a compelling headline, establish a visual direction and bring both together into an idea with a clear point of view. Your particular strengths may lean toward one discipline, but your portfolio should show meaningful contributions to both.

What you’ll do
- Turn business challenges and strategic insights into distinctive creative platforms and integrated campaigns.
- Lead the creative work on assignments from the first conversation through production and delivery, protecting the idea as it evolves.
- Write headlines, scripts, concept narratives and other copy across film, social, digital, out of home, brand voice and other relevant channels.
- For the art-and-copy role, create visual directions, layouts and storyboards that communicate the idea.
- Partner with freelance writers, art directors, designers and other specialists, providing clear direction and useful feedback.
- Recognize when an idea needs stronger writing, better art direction or a different approach entirely.
- Build persuasive presentations and lead creative conversations with clients, explaining the thinking and building confidence in ambitious ideas.
- Help select and brief the right specialists for each assignment.
- Partner with strategy, account leadership and production to deliver strong work within the scope, budget and timeline.
- Contribute to pitches and identify creative opportunities within existing client relationships.

What you’ll bring
- 10+ years in advertising or brand creativity, with experience leading creative work at ACD or Creative Director level.
- A portfolio of original, strategically grounded ideas brought to life across multiple channels.
- Strong writing and editing skills, with range across brands, audiences and tones. The copy-focused role requires exceptional depth in this craft.
- Strong visual judgment and the ability to direct the complete campaign. The art-and-copy role also requires hands-on visual craft and proficiency with relevant design and presentation tools.
- Production experience relevant to your practice, including film, photography or digital content.
- Confidence working directly with clients and navigating feedback without losing the central idea.
- A generous approach to collaboration and the confidence to make clear creative decisions.
- Curiosity about AI and emerging creative tools, with sound judgment about where they improve the work.
- The independence and communication skills to lead within a distributed team.

Show us
A portfolio that demonstrates your craft and creative leadership. Tell us what you made, what you led and how you helped make the work happen.

Working Hours
We are a remote company and welcome candidates based in the US and internationally. Our team generally works Eastern Time hours, and this role requires availability during the standard Eastern Time workday to collaborate with colleagues and meet client needs.

title: Head of Brand
description:
About Viktor

Viktor is the AI employee that lives in Slack and Microsoft Teams, connects to thousands of tools, and does the work: reports, dashboards, code, campaigns. Our mission is to give every company an AI employee.

The team is small. The scope is not.

The Short Version

You make Viktor the unmistakable brand of the AI-employee category. You own the brand system, the campaigns that get Viktor noticed, and the team that ships them. You report to our CMO.

The Hard Part

The category is forming right now and it is crowded, with big tech in it. You compete for attention against companies with far larger budgets, and the role and the structure around it will change regularly.

What You'll Actually Do

Own the brand system: visual identity, voice, narrative and the creative quality bar. 
Run the campaigns that create noise and position Viktor the right way. 
Tell the story that Viktor feels like a colleague: human, capable, direct. 
Build and lead the in-house and agency team that ships brand work with you. 

How You'll Know It's Working

The new identity is live on the site, the product and sales materials. 
One big campaign has shipped and got real attention. 
Brand rules for voice, look and quality bar are written down and used by the team. 
There is a plan for the brand team: who is in-house and what stays with agencies. 

Who You Are

You have taken a brand from early stage through scaling and can show what you built. 
You have run campaigns that made noise in a crowded category. 
You set the bar and still do the work yourself, and you have built a creative team from scratch. 
You have positioned a brand against much larger players. 
You are self-directed, communicate simply, and hold an opinion under push-back. 

Probably Not a Fit If

You need a fixed role and structure. 
You are too senior to do the work yourself. 
Competing with big tech makes you uncomfortable. 

Even Better If

You have worked for a challenger brand in B2C. 
You are strong in video and motion, not only static design. 

Why This Role Is Different

You own the brand of a product already used by tens of thousands of teams, in a category that is forming right now. 
You get to build a new category and the leader in it. 
Remote in Europe or on US Eastern time, with some travel to Warsaw. 

How we work

Small team, high trust, low process. Decisions are made by owners, not committees. You will ship your first week. You will talk to users your first day.

We don't do alignment meetings or stakeholder syncs. We build things, see if they work, and iterate.

Why Viktor

We're one of the fastest-growing companies in the world. The product works. The market is pulling.

This is a rare window: everyone here owns something real. Not a task. A surface of the company that customers depend on.

That doesn't last forever. Right now, it's still true.

Compensation

Top-of-the-market salary and the kind of ownership that only exists at this stage.

The best work happens when you're in the room. Munich, New York, Dublin, and Warsaw. Remote for some roles.

Own generative output end to end for paid social and native: stills that hold the same character across every shot, AI video, lip-sync, and generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to organized, tagged, editor-ready footage. Set the quality bar for generated work and enforce it. Architect the systems that make generation scale past any one person: pipelines, prompt libraries, character reference libraries, internal tooling, and the automation that connects them. Measure how well AI content, and the systems that produce it, are working. What a finished asset costs to make, how long a job takes from approved script to editor handoff, how often work is accepted on the first pass, and how generated work performs in market against everything else we run. Help raise the AI fluency of the whole creative team. Work with Creative Directors and their teams to design AI-enabled tools, systems, processes that improve quality and quantity of output. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted work that ran as paid creative, with an honest account of what you made versus what the model made, and how it performed. You can hold character and continuity across a whole spot, work out why a render broke instead of re-rolling blindly, and get work through platform filters yourself. title: Creative Director (Remote Canada)
description:
Directive Consulting is the leading B2B marketing agency for companies that are done optimizing for metrics that don't move the business. With over a decade of expertise and 420+ B2B brands behind us, we know what real results look like. We operate through 3 divisions: Performance, Communications, and Commerce, each built to share intelligence and align on revenue. Our methodology, DiscoverabilityOS™, aligns brand and demand to guide your ICP to choose you across every decision point. Across Technology, Industrial, and Services verticals, that system spans everything from Paid Media and Content Marketing to PR and Paid Social to Marketplace and Lifecycle Marketing.

At Directive, we're always looking to connect with talented people who care about work that actually counts. As we grow across all 3 divisions, we're seeking forward-thinking people who thrive in fast-paced environments, are obsessed with analytics and storytelling, and are ready to make their mark doing B2B marketing that actually means something.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our Performance Design department — a team that sits at the intersection of creative craft and performance marketing. This is not a traditional Creative Director role. In this role, you will often wear two different “hats”. You'll be equally responsible for the strategic & financial direction of the department and the day-to-day development of the people and work within it. You'll inherit a team with strong momentum, an established methodology, and a clear positioning — and your job is to scale it.

This role reports to senior leadership and manages the full Performance Design team, including designers, project management, and motion contractors.

Creative Leadership & Output

Own the creative vision and quality standard for the Performance Design department
Ensure all work meets both craft and conversion benchmarks — great looking and built to perform
Review and elevate creative across paid social, display, video, and landing page formats
Build systems and workflows that help support excellent creative output for our clients both internally and externally.
Ensure we’re running campaigns vs. ads
Ensure we are testing & learning
Partner with Directive senior leadership to develop our unique and ownable creative process that supports DiscoverabilityOS

People Management & Team Development

Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of designers and motion contractors
Set clear expectations, foster accountability, and build a culture where creative people do their best work
Identify growth opportunities for team members and actively invest in their development

Strategy & Client Partnership

Partner closely with paid media and client success teams to ensure the creative is data-informed from the start
Represent the department in new business pitches, cross-sell opportunities, and client conversations. While you will not be client-facing from a day-to-day perspective with our clients, you will be expected to meet with them monthly during leadership meetings to discuss quality & results.
Articulate the value of Performance Design as a strategic capability, not just an execution function.

Financial Ownership

Own and manage the department P&L - helping to make all budgeting decisions around staffing, tech investments, and other investments for the department.
Monitor margins, manage resourcing decisions with financial impact in mind, and ensure the department operates as a profitable, scalable business unit with monthly revenue targets and direct margin goals.

AI & Technology Integration

Lead adoption of AI creative tools across the team
Identify where emerging technologies can sharpen output and improve efficiency
Build AI into real production workflows — not just as a proof of concept

What You Offer

Experience & Background

5+ years in creative roles within performance marketing, paid media, or growth-focused agency environments
Proven track record in managing creative teams and balancing creative quality with business outcomes
Comfortable presenting department strategy and financial projections to VPs and CMOs, just as much as reviewing a creative brief

Business Acumen

Strong understanding of how a creative department operates as a business
Direct experience managing or having visibility into P&L, margin, and resourcing decisions
You think like an owner and make decisions with financial impact in mind

AI & Tools

Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — generative image, AI-powered video, design analytics, or similar
Knows how to integrate AI into real production workflows, not just demo it
Experience with platforms like EyeQuant, Creatify, or Superside is a plus

Communication & Stakeholder Management

Strong communicator with executive presence who can translate creative thinking into business language
Track record of building trust with both creative practitioners and senior leadership

What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days, you've built strong relationships across the team and key internal stakeholders, identified gaps in methodology and workflow, and begun making your mark on the department's output.
